title: Telemetry Propeller — Standup & Weekly Lab Notes
content:
Week: 2026-06-19 to 2026-06-25
Owner: Aisha Morgan
Purpose: quick lab-style capture from the Propeller standup. Mostly notes-to-self + action items for the tracing + cost telemetry spike. Informal — capture gaps and hypotheses.

Attendees (standup):
- Aisha (obs lead)
- Diego (trace infra)
- Priya (dashboard + UX)
- Liam (cost model)
- Mei (sampling experiment)

Quick TL;DR:
- Sampling experiment v2 running on canary traffic (10% of orgs) — first 48h looked stable; lowered span count by ~22% in tail workloads.
- Dashboard pruning: retire 7 small widgets, combine two span-cost widgets into one compact "avg/span-cost" with filter by model.
- Cost telemetry tag work: tag schema agreed (team, model_variant, route, priority). Diego to finalize mapping to events pipeline.
- Action items assigned, blocked on a small permission change for the dev cluster (infra ticket).

Standup notes (bullety):
- Diego: sampler v2 rollout metrics: 48h -> mean spans/session -12%, p95 spans/session -24% for long-request cohorts (seq>2048). CPU for trace-collector pods down 8% on canary. Saw one spike with incomplete KV cache header — investigating.
- Priya: Dashboard changes ready in branch; moved widgets into a collapsible group to reduce default query load. UX test with internal users next Tue. Need a clean name for combined widget.
- Liam: Cost attribution prototype shows per-span token-weighted cost estimate. Early numbers suggest ~$0.00029 per 1k tokens for traced spans (model-dependent). Need to validate with billing team.
- Mei: Sampling heuristics: added TTL-based sticky sampling (so once a session is sampled, subsequent spans for X mins kept). Helps with high-cardinality sessions. Need to tune TTL.
- Aisha: Noted increased noise in sampling ratio metrics from span-ingestion shard A; possible ingestion skew. Filed JIRA-OBS-426.

Decisions / Notes:
- Keep sampler v2 on canary for 1 more week before expanding to 30% traffic. Metrics to hit: p95 spans/session reduction >= 15% and no >2% regressions in end-to-end latency.
- Adopt the tag schema listed above (team, model_variant, route, priority). Diego will publish a mapping doc for instrumenters.
- Dashboard pruning: merge span-cost widgets into "Average Span Cost (by model)" and make it the default collapsed state for non-admins.
- Experiment dashboard will include a small "financial delta" card that extrapolates monthly savings if sampling is expanded. Liam to own the formula.

Action items (owner — due):
- Diego: publish sampler v2 config and mapping doc to Confluence; include examples for python/java SDKs. (due 2026-06-24)
- Priya: complete UX micro-test and capture qualitative feedback; propose final widget name. (due 2026-06-23)
- Liam: sync with billing ops to validate per-span cost numbers; update cost delta card formula. (due 2026-06-25)
- Mei: run A/B with TTL=5m vs TTL=15m on canary; deliver comparison table. (due 2026-06-22)
- Aisha: follow up on JIRA-OBS-426 (ingestion shard skew); coordinate with infra. (due 2026-06-20)

Open questions / Unknowns:
- How to surface sampling decisions to customers? (opt-in toggle vs automatic opt-out for low-tier) — product input needed.
- Do we need to propagate model_variant tag into the router for legacy routes? This may require quick schema changes in the router.
- Is the per-span cost model defensible for enterprise invoices? Need legal/billing review.

Experiment log (short):
- Sampler v2 (canary): baseline: 2026-06-17 -> spans/session mean=18.7. After v2: mean=16.4. p95 dropped from 93 to 71 for seq>2048 cohort.
- Sticky TTL experiment: with TTL=5m we saw improved end-to-end coherence for traced traces but slightly higher server CPU than baseline.
- Dashboard query load: collapsing 7 widgets reduced default dashboard QPS by ~30% in internal test. Good win.

Notes to self (informal):
- Remember to add trace-id linking in the combined widget (quick link to traces UI).
- Check if we can derive model_variant from request header X-Model-Name for a subset of routes — cheap win.
- Keep experiment flags togglable per-org. We need a safe rollback plan for sampler expansion.

Hand-off / Next week focus:
- Complete sampler docs + SDK snippets (Diego)
- UX micro-test + final widget label (Priya)
- Billing validation and cost-card readiness (Liam)
- TTL tuning and A/B results (Mei)
- Infra follow-up on ingestion skew (Aisha)

Misc links / refs (copied for convenience):
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.company/display/OBS/Telemetry+Propeller+Lab
- JIRA: JIRA-OBS-412 (sampling epic), JIRA-OBS-426 (ingestion skew)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/879 (dashboard pruning)

End of notes. Quick rough capture — will iterate and push an updated version after the TTL A/B completes.
